business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg-China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 22 March 2018, in force)
Luxembourg-United States Double Taxation Agreement (signed 3 April 1996, amended by 2009 Protocol)
Luxembourg General Investment Treaties with major OECD and BRICS partners

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the central register of beneficial owners (RBE); Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (AML/CFT Act), as amended; Law of 12 July 2013 on the Special Limited Partnership (SCSp); Law of 19 December 2002 on the register of commercial undertakings and businesses; CSSF Regulation No. 11-03; applicable CSSF AML/CFT circulars and ESR (end of one hundred and one).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each ultimate beneficial owner (natural persons)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or consular authority in country of origin, certified by a licensed attestation officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Apostille Convention 1961); consular legalization for non-Hague signatory states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate general partner (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry in the general partner's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as required by the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft partnership agreement (acte de société / convention de société) for the Luxembourg SCSp
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg law firm selected by the promoters
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not required for private deed; notarization optional where a notarial deed is chosen for extra validity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of name reservation at the Luxembourg Business Registers (Form RCS-BN-1)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal registry documentation, no external authentication

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all ultimate beneficial owners, general partners, and authorized signatories against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List (for USD transaction rails via Stripe and Etsy Direct Pay), UN Security Council Consolidated List, Luxembourg CSSF National Sanctions List, and the FATF list of high-risk jurisdictions. PEP status as defined by FATF Recommendation 12 triggers enhanced due diligence, senior management approval for establishment of business relationship, and enhanced ongoing monitoring; any positive block or PEP hit requires immediate escalation, written justification, and, if applicable, reporting to the Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — e-RCS portal (www.lbr.lu), 'Réserver une dénomination' (Name Reservation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name must comply with Luxembourg company law (Law of 10 August 1915, as amended) and the Law of 19 December 2002. The name of a Special Limited Partnership must contain the suffix 'SCSp' or the full French designation 'Société en commandite spéciale'. Names must be expressed in French, German, Luxembourgish, or a language commonly used in international commerce (English is acceptable); any non-Latin script (e.g., Chinese) must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet for official registration. All statutory registration and filing documents must be drafted in French or German.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Assurance, Réassurance, Fiduciaire, Fonds, Investissement, OPC, OPCVM, SICAV, SICAF
État, Gouvernement, Luxembourg, Ville de Luxembourg (when implying state or municipal patronage without ministerial approval)
Chambre des Députés, Justice, Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF)
Any term implying public authority, regulated financial services, or statutory monopolies
Names that are identical, confusingly similar, or misleadingly similar to an existing registered entity
Obscene or contrary to public policy names
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: not permitted by statute; an expired name reservation is automatically null and a new application must be filed after a fresh availability search. Rejection appeal: under Article 14 of the Law of 19 December 2002 and Article 1019 of the Luxembourg New Code of Civil Procedure, the applicant may file a petition in the chamber of council ('requête en référé') before the District Court of Luxembourg (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg) within one month of the registry's written refusal. The court may reverse the registry's decision and order the reservation. As an alternative, the applicant may submit revised name proposals directly to the LBR within two weeks of refusal, which is the standard and faster administrative remedy.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial. A mere mailbox or forward-facing virtual office without a Luxembourg-based compliance structure is not acceptable for registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS). However, registered domiciliation services are authorized under the Law of 31 May 1999 and are widely used in practice for SCSp and holding vehicles. The SCSp must maintain its registered office at a physical address in Luxembourg where legal correspondence can be served, and it must have adequate substance to justify its commercial activity. For the requested industry (Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges), a professional domiciliation address with a licensed agent will satisfy RCS and CSSF requirements, provided the domiciliation agent is operating under a legal authorization and accounts for the business as a genuine leasing of premises, not purely an administrative margin.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 0.2 (20% probability of an unannounced physical or records-procedure inspection within the first 12 months of operation, based on standard RCS/CSSF inspection risk metrics for a low-risk merchandising activity; commercial substance and AML/CFT records must be ready for production at the registered office).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation fee for the SCSp at the Luxembourg Business Registers (e-RCS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff as set out in the RCS fees schedule (€15.00 per reservation, USD conversion at 1.087 EUR/USD)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation filing with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: District Court of Luxembourg / Luxembourg Business Registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory court and registry fee (€75.00) for the new entity filing under the Law of 19 December 2002

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration filing to the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee of €75.00 per UBO filing (non-refundable)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille of identification documents (certified passport copies, corporate good standing certificates) for all required persons
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent notary public, apostille office, or consular authority in the country of origin (e.g., Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for 3–4 documents in China/USA/EU jurisdictions, including courier charges and apostille certifications

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional legal translation of the partnerships constitution and supporting documents from English/Chinese into French (mandatory for RCS filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified legal translator – Luxembourg or European Economic Area based
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark at €0.35–€0.50 per word for certified legal translation of a standard SCSp incorporation pack

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal fees for the drafting of the SCSp partnership agreement (acte de société), UBO identification analysis, and pre-incorporation due diligence opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Luxembourg market rate of €2,500 – €5,000 fixed fee for SCSp formation; here allocated at €3,200 (USD approx.)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional domiciliation / registered office service for the SCSp – first year (compliance address and representation in Luxembourg)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (e.g., AltaTrust, BDO, Intertrust) under the Law of 31 May 1999
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated market price of €1,200 – €1,800 per year for flat annual domiciliation, including mail handling and statutory notification forwarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and sanctions screening report covering UBO, general partner, authorized representatives, business counterparties, and PEP exposure
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated AML/CFT compliance provider (automated screening tool or boutique consultancy)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a low-risk commercial individual/legal entity package, including OFAC/EU/UN consolidated list checks and PEP database access

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Articles 101-1 to 101-12 (special limited partnership – SCSp); implemented by the Law of 23 July 2016 on the special limited partnership; registration governed by the Law of 19 December 2002 on the trade and companies register (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), acting as delegated registrar of the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) attached to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration d'inscription au Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – electronic filing of the partnership agreement extracts (contrat de société) via the eJustice/LBR e-filing platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital, no paid-up capital requirement, and no escrow account rule for the SCSp; partners are free to determine contributions in the partnership agreement and may contribute in cash or in kind.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the partnership agreement of the Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp) in the statutory form presented to this meeting be and is hereby approved and adopted in full; that the initial subscription of partnership interests and the contributions of the general and limited partners, as set forth in the contribution schedule, be and are hereby ratified; that the registered office of the SCSp be and is hereby fixed at the address stated in the minutes; that [Name] be and is hereby appointed as general partner and gérant with sole authority to represent and bind the SCSp; and that the gérant be and is hereby authorized to execute all registrations with the Luxembourg Business Registers, tax authorities, and banks, and to procure all required operational permits, each as necessary to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the partnership agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: External Luxembourg notary (optional) or civil-law notary; alternatively, private deed signed by all partners in accordance with Article 101-2 of the 1915 Law.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the SCSp partnership agreement (contrat de société) in French or English, setting out corporate name, registered office, corporate object (manufacture and sale of die-struck brass enamel lapel pins), general partner identity and powers, limited partner commitments, profit-sharing and management clauses. The deed must be signed by all founding partners; notarization is required only if any contribution consists of immovable property. Execute a notarized or private deed and arrange certified translations into French if drafted in English.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each founding partner
Certificate of good standing and constitutional documents if a partner is a legal entity
Proof of residential or registered address of each partner
Power of attorney for any signing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS queries the deed for missing information, partners must cure the omission by executing an addendum or correcting clause within 15 days; refusal may be appealed to the Luxembourg District Court within one month of the formal refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve and verify the corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – name availability desk operated through the eJustice portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed SCSp name for prior electronic reservation and availability check, ensuring no confusing similarity with existing Luxembourg companies, trademarks, or protected designations. The name must include the designation 'SCSp' or 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' and comply with public order rules prohibiting misleading or scandalous terms. Online name verification is recommended before the formal registration filing.
required_dossiers: Corporate object summary for name adequacy assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, the applicant may file an administrative request for reconsideration with LBR within 10 days or submit an alternative name; an adversarial decision may be appealed to the administrative tribunal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic registration filing with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) – electronic filing unit via the eJustice/LBR e-filing platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed partnership agreement as a PDF, complete the standardized SCSp registration form, validate partner and manager data, and pay the RCS filing fee online. The filing must be signed electronically using a Luxembourg eID or Luxtrust-compatible digital certificate held by the gérant or an authorized legal counsel. The LBR will review formal compliance of the submitted extract and, upon approval, allocate the registration number in the Luxembourg national trade register.
required_dossiers: Executed partnership agreement in admissible format
Proof of electronic signature authority (Luxtrust certificate/eID)
List of directors/managers with personal data
Declaration on beneficial ownership (for anti-money-laundering verification)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On rejection due to incomplete particulars, the LBR issues a reasoned query; the filing must be corrected and resubmitted within 15 days; further refusal may be challenged before the Luxembourg District Court (Chambre du conseil).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete publication in RESA and obtain registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations) publication service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following approval, the LBR automatically publishes the registration extract in the Electronic Compendium of Companies and Associations (RESA). The SCSp then fetches its RCS number, an official registration certificate (extrait du RCS), and a VAT identification number (TVA) through the Luxembourg direct tax administration (Administration des contributions directes) upon request. Obtain the registration certificate and keep it for bank account opening and commercial contracting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RESA publication is delayed or the certificate contains data errors, the LBR may be requested in writing to rectify within 5 business days; erroneous entries detrimental to third parties may be corrected through an addendum filed at the RCS.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy – Directorate General for Industry (Direction Générale de l'Industrie) and the Municipal Business Licensing Authority (Administration communale) for workshop premises; further guidance through Guichet.lu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Optional Establishment Authorization (Autorisation d'établissement) under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 on access to artisan, commercial, and industrial professions; not mandatorily required for micro-scale cross-border distance sale of novelty enamel pins, but recommended if a physical production workshop is opened in Luxembourg.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'Environnement – Environment Agency of Luxembourg (AEV)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – low-risk category D; the production of die-struck enamel lapel pins is not listed in Annex I of the Luxembourg environmental impact assessment law, therefore no full EIA report is required; however, a waste registration (déclaration de déchets) may be necessary for polishing sludge and enamel residue.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater from polishing and rinsing operations must not exceed discharge limits for nickel (1.0 mg/L), lead (0.5 mg/L), and suspended solids (50 mg/L) when released to the municipal sewer, in accordance with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 21 December 1994 on wastewater discharges; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from enamel solvents must be managed under the solvent management threshold transposing EU Directive 2010/75/EU; solid enamel waste must be segregated and collected by an approved waste operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance issued by the Grand-Ducal Fire and Rescue Corps (CGDIS) for premises operating kilns or ovens, including structural fire-resistance inspection and certification of the enameling furnace area; building structural integrity certificate by the municipal building authority; occupational health and workplace safety clearance from the Inspectorate of Labour and Mines (ITM), including ventilation, protective equipment, and noise control compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) as the central money and FX authority within the Eurosystem/ECB framework; the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) supervises credit institutions and payment/e-money institutions for AML/KYC purposes. Luxembourg has no separate national foreign-exchange administration; exchange-control policy is fully delegated to the ECB and the EU free-movement-of-capital regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts. Luxembourg has no exchange-control approvals, no capital-export restrictions, no repatriation licensing, and no tax-clearance requirement on profit remittances payable by an SCSp to non-resident partners. Capital injections, trade payments, distributions, and liquidation proceeds flow freely across borders, subject only to EU anti-money-laundering, sanctions, economic-substance, and BCL balance-of-payments statistical reporting rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. There are no statutory surrender requirements, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no maximum holding periods for export receipts in foreign currency. An SCSp engaged in enamel-pin exports may retain EUR, USD, CNY, or other foreign-currency balances freely and may convert them through any Luxembourg or EEA-authorized bank counterparty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EUR); escrow-capable sub-account for subscription capital
Operational Account (EUR) with merchant settlement functionality
Operational Account (EUR) for trade settlement and treasury sweeps
Capital Escrow Account (EUR) during KYC verification; converted to Operational Account after RBE proof

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium with restrictive caveats. EEA-licensed payment/e-money institutions are viable for collecting Etsy and Stripe marketplace proceeds and for sweeping funds into the primary Luxembourg bank account; offshore or non-EEA EMIs are not viable because unlicensed payment activity in Luxembourg triggers CSSF enforcement. Core operational banking for the SCSp should remain with a tier-1 Luxembourg credit institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one physical-person signatory or gérant must attend an in-person onboarding interview at the Luxembourg branch; remote video identification is permitted by certain banks only for secondary signatories or for low-risk EU-resident individuals. Non-EU corporate partners must provide notarized and apostilled passports, constitutional documents, and passport-quality identity verification. A physical meeting at the relationship manager's office remains the prevailing mandate for SCSp vehicles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU partner opacity or undisclosed ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) chain behind the SCSp
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified SCSp partnership agreement, RCSL company extract, RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) confirmation, organizational chart with full UBO cascade, apostilled passport copies of all UBOs, independent sanctions/PEP screening report, and source-of-wealth statement for each non-EU partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mailbox-company profile with insufficient economic substance in Luxembourg
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Domiciliation agreement with a licensed Luxembourg service provider, substance policy file, local management/accounting service contracts, minutes of partner meetings, Etsy/Stripe commercial evidence, purchase orders from customers, and customs declarations proving physical trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce pass-through pattern: daily Stripe/Etsy settlements without a matching export document trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements, settlement reports, order-level buyer and country data, logistics and shipment tracking records, commercial invoices in the SCSp's name, transfer-pricing documentation demonstrating an arm's-length margin, and a written explanation of the commercial flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large one-off advance payment from a new wholesale buyer in a high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Third-party due-diligence file on the buyer, audited financial statements or bank confirmation letter, signed supply/purchase agreement, anti-corruption and export-control certificates, completed KYC questionnaire, and an explicit source-of-funds declaration for the advance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between the stated ISIC 3240 enamel-pin manufacturing activity and the legal name displayed on payment platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trademark or brand license agreement, platform registration certificate under the SCSp's commercial name, pro-forma invoices, EORI/VAT registration, customs documents, and a sworn declaration explaining the principal-to-principal trade structure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident partner funds must be routed through SWIFT/TARGET2 or SEPA Instant using ISO 20022 payment messages (MT103 or pain.001). The remitting bank should populate the Purpose element with an appropriate direct-investment/capital-increase code (e.g., ISO 20022 'EQUI' for equity subscription) and include the narrative 'SCSp capital contribution – [capital call reference]'. The receiving Luxembourg bank validates the SCSp's RBE/UBO status, the capital-call notice, and the partnership agreement before crediting the escrow or operational account. For USD or CNY injections, use a correspondent clearing corridor via Fedwire/CHIPS or CIPS/offshore CNH; no prior exchange-control approval is required, but BCL balance-of-payments and direct-investment statistical surveys must be completed where thresholds apply.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for EUR/foreign-currency wire payments, with local clearing alternatives (SEPA for EU suppliers, CHAPS for UK, Fedwire/ACH for US, CNAPS/CIPS for CNY, IMPS/RTGS for INR, FAST for HKD) through Luxembourg correspondent banks. For high-value raw-material contracts (brass blanks, enamel paints, packaging), irrevocable commercial letters of credit under UCP600 (SWIFT MT700) and standby letters of credit under ISP98 are the standard clearing rails. URDG 758-compliant bank guarantees are used for advance-payment protection on long-term Asian supply agreements. Etsy/Stripe marketplace settlements are swept from the EMI/merchant account to the SCSp's operational account at BCL-monitored banks, with automated reconciliation via camt.054 cash-management statements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD deliverable outright forwards with maturity up to 24 months
EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and EUR/CNH FX swaps
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) on EUR/USD
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only for restricted currencies where physical delivery is legally impossible, such as onshore CNY
European-style currency options (calls, puts, and zero-premium collars)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration (Déclaration Annuelle) to the Luxembourg Business Registers confirming the RCS registered details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March, confirming the RCS data as at the preceding 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing triggers a formal reminder and court enforcement action; persistent non-compliance may lead to a judicial strike-off from the RCS and personal liability of the general partner and managers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (Comptes Annuels) filing with the RCS — only if the SCSp is within the Commercial Code publication obligation and not eligible for an exemption
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — RCS, electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the partners; approval must occur within six months of the financial year-end (calendar-year SCSp: approval by 30 June, filing by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file exposes the SCSp and its general partner to an injunction initiated by the RCS/Public Prosecutor, administrative fines and, after continued default, removal from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) declaration update on any transfer of partnership interests or change in UBO details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of any change in beneficial ownership; annual confirmation is coordinated with the RCS annual declaration by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 125,000 for legal entities or equivalent liability of the general partner, plus potential RCS enforcement and strike-off for repeated failure

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SCSp if it exceeds at least two of the three Luxembourg statutory size criteria: total balance sheet EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million and average workforce 50 employees; audit is also mandatory if the entity belongs to a group subject to consolidated audit or is a regulated collective investment/securitization vehicle.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP as applied under the Commercial Code (articles 1581–1615) and the amended Law of 19 December 2002; IFRS as adopted by the EU is optional for consolidated financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO re-filing is required in the absence of changes; the RCS annual declaration is the annual verification event. Any transfer of partnership interests or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported to the RBE within one month, and the internal register of partners/UBOs must be updated at the same time.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500–USD 5,000 per annum for domiciliation, registered office and corporate secretarial administration by a Luxembourg service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000–USD 25,000 per annum when a statutory audit is triggered; nil if the SCSp is below all applicable audit thresholds

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate for taxable corporate entities (17% CIT, 7% solidarity surcharge, 6.75% municipal business tax in Luxembourg City); the SCSp is fiscally transparent and not itself subject to CIT/MBT.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp pass-through election: income, deductions and credits flow to partners; partner-level participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains; no entity-level net wealth tax on the transparent SCSp; no IP box relevance to enamel-pin manufacturing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1000 (Corporate Income Tax / Municipal Business Tax return) and Form 100 (partnership information declaration for the fiscally transparent SCSp); e-filed through the eCDF portal via MyGuichet.lu, with the RBE (beneficial owner) annual confirmation annexed.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Calendar-year taxpayers: 31 December of the year following the tax year; non-calendar fiscal years: within six months after fiscal year-end; extensions (prolongation) available on request to the AED.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SCSp legal name, RCS number, Luxembourg tax ID, address and principal activity (ISIC 3240 manufacturing of enamel lapel pins).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the SCSp identity and Luxembourg tax number; attach the partnership deed and full list of non-resident partners with their residence addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of SCSp legal form and confirmation of pass-through eligibility under the Law of 12 July 2013 (as amended).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that no CIT/MBT is due at SCSp level; declare that all income is allocated to partners per profit-sharing ratios.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Worldwide income attributable to the SCSp for the fiscal year, itemised by source (Etsy and Stripe sales, manufacturing expenses, overheads).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate the allocable profit or loss to each resident and non-resident partner in accordance with the SCSp agreement; attach partner allocation schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest, royalties and dividends received or paid by the SCSp, including any Luxembourg-source passive income subject to withholding tax obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate any Luxembourg-source interest/royalty flows to non-resident partners for WHT assessment (generally 0% under domestic law).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of intra-group transactions, transfer pricing method applied, and confirmation of arm's length character.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners conducting cross-border sales of enamel pins through the SCSp must attach a TP summary if group turnover exceeds the statutory thresholds; otherwise file a nil annex.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an ex officio assessment (taxation d'office), a late-filing penalty of up to EUR 25,000, and late-payment interest of 0.6% per month on any assessed balance; intentional failure to file constitutes tax fraud under Article 1063 AO, punishable by imprisonment and fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory dividend withholding tax; 0% exemption under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (>=10% participation held for >=12 months); for the fiscally transparent SCSp, distributions to partners are generally not subject to WHT at entity level, provided the transparency election is respected and partners are the economic owners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Form 270 (application for reduced/exempt withholding at source) to the Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration (AED) before the distribution date, attaching a valid tax residence certificate (TRC) from the partner's jurisdiction of residence; refunds of excess WHT can be claimed via Form 280; the SCSp must maintain partner-by-partner UBO and TRC documentation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic law: 0% WHT on outbound interest and royalties; most Luxembourg DTAs also allocate exclusive taxing rights to the residence state or provide 0%/reduced rates; treaty relief conditioned on TRC and economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 50,000,000 consolidated group turnover AND Luxembourg intra-group transactions exceeding EUR 100,000 for financial transactions (loans, royalties, licences) or EUR 500,000 for goods/services in a tax year; documentation must be filed with the AED within 30 days of a formal request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No dedicated ESR statute (unlike UAE/BVI), but Article 6 Steueranpassungsgesetz (AbgAO) and the EU ATAD GAAR require real establishment, personnel, premises, and strategic decision-making in Luxembourg; a substance-light SCSp risks loss of tax residency, denial of treaty benefits, reclassification as fully taxable, and application of CFC rules at partner level.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission or false declaration of SCSp income, fabricated deductions, or concealment of non-resident partner profit shares in the annual Form 1000/100 filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 1063 AO: fine up to EUR 25,000 or up to double the evaded tax for aggravated fraud; late-payment interest at 0.6% per month; criminal conviction with imprisonment of up to 5 years in qualified cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Authorized partners or directors who signed false returns are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, face criminal imprisonment, asset seizure, disqualification from office, and a court-imposed travel ban.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SCSp operated without premises, employees, or genuine economic risk, used solely to channel Etsy/Stripe enamel-pin profits to low-tax foreign partners with no business purpose.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AED disregards the pass-through election, reclassifies the SCSp as subject to 24.94% CIT/MBT on deemed profit, denies treaty and directive benefits, and imposes a minimum net wealth tax charge up to EUR 169,437 for taxable entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly liable for the unpaid corporate tax under the management-liability doctrine, fined in re-characterization proceedings, and subjected to a travel ban pending full restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) declaration, omission of the ultimate beneficial owner of the enamel-pin enterprise, or accepting Stripe/Etsy payments without conducting partner due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law of 13 January 2019 (RBE): fines up to EUR 1,250,000 for legal persons and up to EUR 250,000 for individuals; daily penalty payments for persistent default; the AML law of 12 November 2004 criminalises intentional money laundering with imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines, criminal prosecution, freezing orders, disqualification from directing any Luxembourg entity, and preventive travel bans imposed by the public prosecutor.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-submission of Local File / Master File within 30 days of an AED request or pricing intra-group enamel-pin sales without an arm's length margin under TNMM.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty up to 10% of the re-determined TP adjustment; default interest at 0.6% per month; the law of 28 January 2021 empowers the AED to impose separate penalties for incomplete documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing the tax declaration assume TP accuracy; upon upward adjustment they may be personally liable for additional tax, interest, and penalties, with potential judicial travel bans imposed in cases of intentional under-declaration.
